nom: SUNDAY RILEY Good Genes All-In-One Lactic Acid Treatment

avis.texte: The value and benefits far exceed the price. Very gentle on my senstive , combination skin. Works wonderfully. Ive used this product for years. Lasts a really long time. Leaves my skin soft, even, and radiant.

I've been using this for years. This makes a noticeable difference within the first few days you use it. It brightens your face and takes away the dullness of mature skin. This is a splurge for me, but it works. Highly recommend.

avis.titre: Do not use if you shave your face
avis.texte: This stuff BURNS. Like it BURN BURNS. I dont have sensitive skin. I have viking skin. I also shave my face, i am now broken out on one side of my face. This stuff ain't worth it. If it was super good, I would deal with the burning, but its not. Its over priced, its just got a pretty name and a slightly r*cist under tone (ulta wont let us say r*cist? Someones about to get their business blown up). I think, as women, we can do better.

Got a trial size as part of a promotion, and was using as a spot corrector. My skin IMMEDIATELY clears up. Came back to see about buying a full size, but my goodness the price 😭 5-star product, the 3 stars are for pricing.

avis.titre: Inconsistant/ Gamble if itll work or not
avis.texte: When you get a good bottle its the best exfoliator out there, brightens, plumps, makes large pores tiny/non existant in litteral mins! I love it and it would be my go to EXCEPT... thats only if you get a good bottle. Some bottle are miracles some are complete trash the do nothing they actually make ur skin look worse... I dont usually write reviews like ever but I feel like its important for people to know it if its doing nothing it prob not you its most likely just a bad bottle. ITS A GAMBLE forsure. I wrote them explaining this has happened multiple times over the course of a couple yrs, sometimes it would be amazing other times it would ruin my skin.
I noticed results within days of starting use. Smoother complexion, softer skin, more even tone fast. I'm obsessed.
This product is amazing. Ive been using it for about 3 years now and it just makes my skin look so much better during the day.

avis.titre: ✨ This product has changed my skin for the better ✨
avis.texte: I started using Sunday Riley Good Genes (Lactic Acid) back in 2023 when my melasma had flared up badly, and it honestly became one of the few products that made a noticeable difference. After a few months of consistent use, I saw drastic improvements in the look of my discoloration and overall tone. My skin looked brighter, smoother, and more even, and my texture felt noticeably softer. What I love most is that it delivers real results without feeling harsh or stripping, and it layered well with the rest of my routine. It's one of those "you can actually see it" products, and I keep coming back to it when my skin starts looking dull or uneven again. Pricey, yes, but for me it was worth it because it genuinely helped calm down a stubborn melasma flare and made my skin look healthier overall.

I always go back to Good Genes , I have sensitive mature skin that gets dry but also breakouts .. this helps clear the dead skin on a cellular level it's irritated or red it just looks dewy and healthy. I use this for healing deep pimples too to prevent dark spots after they are gone. Combine with a nice C oil and some gel cream I like ceo and dermalogica or comfort care (Davines skin care) I get so many compliments about my skin when I stick to this routine

I purchased the skin routine kit the first 2 items in the kit were great, but when i got to the 3rd item (lactic acid) I put the product on my forehead and was moving downward and immediately a burning sensation started then where i olaces the product started burning it was unbearable! I immediately splash my face with cold water but the damage was done! My face was terribly burned! It was truly awful! I still have scarring on my forehead!

Well, I originally got this in my Boxy subscription. It kind of tingled right away and I put it aside and didn't use it for a while. I decided I would try because I have some redness and due to having an olive complexion, if I get a zit it remains a dark spot for months. I started using it a few times a week, at night. I would do my skincare and I would dispense one or two pumps on the top of my left hand. I would dab it on my face and continue to use my left hand as the place I would consistently apply the product from. I thought it was working but then I realized my left hand compared to my right, the texture was gone from my hand, any dark spots were gone from my hand and after a few weeks of using it the results were so noticeable I would show my family and friends. I highly recommend this product to people! it definitely works on your face, skin, hands and my sister is using it for her melasma.
Feels like it gives a glow I have been using it twice a day I would buy it again. I am new to skin care. It is supposed to to exfoliate so I'm trusting it does. I moisturize on top as instructed
Totally worth it- skin is so soft and bright . Tingles first time but using it twice a week makes my face feel amazing.
Works so good I'm going to spend my whole life repurchasing 😩

avis.titre: The only product I'm willing to spend this amount
avis.texte: This was given to me as a gift and I will definitely be purchasing this myself when I run out because this stuff is amazing! I do have sensitive skin so I only use it every other night and it does wonders for exfoliating and clearing up my skin.
The before and after pictures are a lie. They all say after a few weeks. My before and after look that way after one night! One! Night!! The best skincare you can buy

I dont believe in gatekeeping but honestly I do a little with this product. Works so well and so quickly, I've tried cheaper options and fiferent brands but this one is one of a kind. Worth the price just wish they spent less money on the packaging so I could get more product.

avis.titre: the one product I don't want to be without
avis.texte: I absolutely love this product!!! It is a little expensive, but it is worth it The two things I don't want to be without is Sunday Riley Good Genes and Peter Thomas Roth Retinol!!

I've been using Good Genes for only a few weeks and I already see the difference in texture, brightness, and fading of fine lines and under eye bags! I wish I'd found Sunday Riley products far sooner than I did!
Works so good that I was truly amazed! And you can notice a difference in a few days!

avis.titre: I Would Never Pay Full Price
avis.texte: At 50% off it is an okay Lactic Acid leave-on but there are many other products that do the same thing at a lower price point. This was a 21 days of Beauty Deals purchase and I'm. It sad I tried it.

This is my go to, found it about 2 years ago. I love the way it has treated my skin on my face. I use pretty much daily unless running low, then it's every few days. My only complaint is the bottle is white, so you can tell when it's low. I use every drop.

avis.titre: Mission - better skin for my wedding
avis.texte: Overall the product has a great milky texture with a pleasant scent. I immediately noticed a brightening affect after one night and my skin was super soft. One star off as it will take time to see any difference on dark spots/scars.

I bought this very expensive cream because Dr. Shereene Idriss recommended it for sensitive skin. I used 3 or 4 times and now I have contact dermatitis so bad that I had to see a doctor and get a prescription for a steroid ointment.
I am very happy with the results I am seeing in my skin since I started using this product. I will keep re-ordering Good Genes.
I loveee the Sunday Riley collection! It is so so good! After just a few uses my face is so much brighter and smoother

Unfortunately for my wallet this product works amazingly well. I've actually just emptied my 3rd bottle. I have pretty balanced to dry skin, my main skin concern is always texture. This product will take my skin from the crustiest depths to clear skin. People always compliment skin and this is the one product I have consistently used for 4 years. There's nothing like it.

avis.titre: Very Good Product on 2nd mth - Not so good Packaging
avis.texte: I have tried probably over a couple dozen Lactic Acid products. I have sensitive skin, combinations also with sun damage from my 20's. I am in my early 50's now with minimal fine lines around my eyes but had strong frown line between eyes. I have used it for a month with the CEO cream and I have seen a difference. There is a younger feel, brighter glow and a more youthful overall look to my skin. Give the product a chance at least a month remember this is a skin product not the fountain of youth. You have to set a realistic expectation from your skin care routine. Also this product is for under, around your eyes and up to your brow if you have sensitive skin do not put it on your eyelids. But from someone who has tried many products expensive and less expensive I like this product I see change in my skin texture, color, dullness, reduces puffiness to a degree(I think that took a little longer) and even fine lines. I gave it 4 stars only because of the packaging I have learned when the bottle is out of pumps it doesnt mean the bottle is empty I opened it up and found more inside so I took off one star for that.
I'm using Good Genes for a while now. And I really love this product ❤️.

Listen, I'm not a skincare girlie, but my mom tossed me this because she didn't like the smell (it smells like black licorice sort of) and its one of the only times I've actually noticed my skin looking better than it usually does. I am going to try a dupe now that I went to rebuy and a 9 dollar alternative immediately came up. I'm assuming Lactic acid is Lactic acid.

avis.titre: I will purchase this product again
avis.texte: This product is a game changer. I have purchased many products and this one has exceeded my expectations. My skin feels and looks more radiant and the fine lines are barely visible. The difference was noticeable within one week. I am very happy with this product and the salesman, Nate, who introduced me to the product.
Great Serum for day and night use. My complexion has been brighter and smoother

Although I did see results with this product, it lasted less than a month and I used less than the suggested amount. I took the bottle apart to get every last, expensive drop and I was shocked at the packaging. What a scam! They should be ashamed!

avis.titre: not a lot of product, misleading
avis.texte: it looks like a good amount in the bottle but its just a illusion, its just a small bag in a big bottle. but i liked the product but just dont think worth that much money.
I was hesitant to purchase but glad I did so. It's a good maintenance and balancing serum, feel I've seen some texture and tone improvement.

Can definitely tell that it is the real thing (lactic acid, that is), because it stings like crazy when you have a healing blemish! It's a short-term sting though, so not unbearable. The packaging is tricky to get every last bit out- but you can tell that they put thought into trying to utilize a system that gets you every last drop. Love this stuff.

I used to use this product 2023, worked amazing. I purchased another bottle 2024, it made my eyes swell, skin welt with what looked like hives. I tried 2 days ago (new bottle), the lactic acid did it again, welts and burning red, swelling around eye.
This stuff is a miracle worker. I struggle with dry patches and this fixes that. Pores look smaller, fine lines disappear, skin looks so glowy and smooth. I'll continue to repurchase for sure
I use this like a serum. My skin is so much clearer and brighter when I use it. By far my favorite Sunday Riley product and favorite acid exfoliant.

I really wanted this to work but it did nothing after 2 small bottles nightly. I'm 65 and have started really late with the face lotions so after reading about Sunday Riley I tried it with high hopes but nothing. I don't know if it was bad because it had a really old smell to it. Some people talked about a smell but I wouldn't think it would be from being old or being transported in high heat. I don't know except I kept using it nightly until I ran out and it didn't do anything unless it caused me to get rosacea at 65 which it is intense and now I can't use any lotion on my face because it will cause a severe outbreak.

GOOD GENES ALL-IN-ONE LACTIC ACID TREATMENT This product has been consistently used for the past 4 nights and I am seeming satisfied thus far about the quality. It is gently but still effective without over irritating my skin. I do notice mt skin a little more red after use. The Good Genes has proven itself worthy of staying in my collection long term. I will be tapering off this product to use every other week. The weeks in between daily use I will be using this as a mask twice in 7 days. Sunday Riley did not disappoint! The Glow Goals set is a perfect introductory for me. After several years of wanting to try these products I will not be without again.
It has a very off putting smell in application. I checked the reviews to see if this is supposed to be the smell but it is not the case. Not sure yet if I would recommend.
I was late to the skincare game but one of my first high end investments was the Sunday Riley Good Genes along with the Luna. Made a world of difference in my skin immediately.

avis.titre: Too darn expensive for what it does !
avis.texte: When did these skin care lotion become so expensive, this serum didn't do that much and i used it for 6 months as a both 2 bottles last yr . But the increase price !? It's ridiculous!!

avis.titre: Ugh that price but worth it
avis.texte: I got a sample of this for my birthday and fell in love. The audible gasp when I saw the price though LOL still, 10/10. Worth every penny.

I love the product but am disappointed in the packaging. Product make my skin soft and smooth. The bottle is deceiving because its painted white and there is a plastic bladder inside that holds the product. I'm not sure it contains the full ounces as described because it did not last long.

I received a free sample of a week's worth of Good Genes. I noticed a difference on the 2nd day! I've never spent over $100 for ANY beauty product, but after using Good Genes, I'm now a loyal user! You don't need a lot of product and the longer I use it the bettery skin looks. I absolutely recommend Good Genes to any skincare fanatic like me.

Okay so minor details about myself /im aa with combo skin and prone to breakouts , i had dark under eyes and some hyperpigmentation that i needed to go away . I had got the sampler on my biryhday and girllll let me tell you ! I wished ive used this sooner ! Ive been using its sense Saturday and my dark circles almost gone ! The hyperpigmentation on my chin almost gone ! The acne almost gone ! Like this product is the truth… my oily skin almost gone ! Like sis im literally going back to get the mjni bottle because again a little goes alongggg way, you buy it once a month you should be good ! And yes its pricey to be getting once a month but its a good investment overall / also does have a bit of a tingle when you first use but thats just your bodys way of trying to figure out what it is.
My go to when I have sporadic breakouts. I normally use it at nigjt after I tone my skin.

avis.titre: I have repurchased this more than 10 times!
avis.texte: I love all Sunday Riley products but this serum, when applied bedtime, has you waking up with glowing skin. Not irritating to my very sensitive skin!
I have SO many serums and now only use this. Makes skin bright, even and radiant. Get rid of everything else, just use this. You won't be disappointed. Worth every penny.
Highly recommend. I first put it on the back on my hand so u can really see if it will work or not. I was surprised. It really does work. I use it around my eyes, hands, neck & chest.

This is the best skin product I have ever used. After two or three uses, my face feels so smooth, as if I just had microdermabrasion and a peel. In fact, I haven't had microdermabrasion or a peel since I started using it seven months ago and my skin looks just as good. Highly recommend

This product is a ripoff! Sample size product, paying full price . I was shocked when it was difficult to get the pump out, thinking i would scrape out the only to fine a suction type tube in there. I had to cut the plastic to get the remaining drop out. Such a disappointment.

I was excited to try this and chose a mini sample as my birthday gift. Unlike with most samples where you can see some sort of effect even after one use, this did absolutely nothing for my skin. I usually feel a tingle with exfoliating products but this was like using any other watery lotion. I cant even say I'm glad i tried it.

I had acne in the past but it has been 5+ years since I delt with it. I only experiance maybe 1-2 pimples around my period that only last 2-5 days. After 3 weeks of this product my skin looks so bad and has painful cystic acne and white heads. I am going to have to go to a dermatologist to fix my skin now! For reference I was using this once a week for 15 minutes on my skin and rinishing off and had zero irratation when I applied it. So when i began to notice pimples appearing I thought it may be working, until I started to get deep painfil pimples rhat are not hoing away now even with a week of not using it. ( this was also the only new profuct added to my routine to help with dry patches) This product has severaly caused damage to my self confidence as well as now needing to correct my painful pimple covered skin.
I just tried a sample of this and omg I'm going to but the biggest bottle it's works so good !

I love this product - if I could give it 10 stars, I would. It clears up any acne I may have going on and also reduces much of the redness that I have. It is too expensive, though. For me, this product needs to be used consistently but I just cant afford that. It's such a shame because if I actually had a list of "holy grail" products, this one would be and stay at the very top of it, I'm sure.

I adore Sunday Riley and the Good Genes lactic acid treatment is no exception! I don't feel like I've completed my skincare routine without it. I love the way it makes my face feel tingly so I know it's really working its magic. Definitely a must have!
It works…fresh glowy skin after only a few uses. Definitely worth the money. Especially for us over 50. Highly recommend.

avis.titre: Get better skin on the FIRST use!
avis.texte: I bought this mini size to travel with me. If I could bathe in this, I would! You look younger and more radiant with the first use. Apply morning and night after toner and you will not be disappointed!
This was one of the first products I started using everyday. I really have notice my skin has a glow now. However I have started several products now. This stuff is amazing...
This is a great product, removed wrinkles from my forehead. My skins looks and feels much younger and healthier. I would recommend to anyone!

This brand has me sold ! I love this treatment serum almost as much as I love my husband . The lactic acid gently exfoliates while leaving your skin smooth and radiant . I swear its worth the price tag $$ . I held out for my coupon and purchased the big bottle and one pump is plenty for full face / neck . I will continue to keep this in my skin care regime , thank you SUNDAY RILEY !

avis.titre: My laugh lines are straight up GONE
avis.texte: I switched to this serum after feeling meh about Kate Somerville's Exfolkate, which I've used for awhile and never felt that it was doing much. I'm really glad I made the switch. This stuff is hardcore. I usually have strong skin (meaning the opposite of sensitive) but I occasionally feel burning when using this product, so I would NOT recommend for those with sensitive skin. However, since I started using for a few weeks, I think my laugh lines have almost completely disappeared. To be fair, I use other skincare products so some of that could be attributed to those (retinol, growth factor serum, etc). But I feel like the disappearance of these lines matched up more with when I started using this product. The price is high which is why I am giving the product 4/5 stars (plus for being maybe too strong for others to use) but if you're not worried about price or strength, then definitely give this a try.
love this product. smells great, looks great, feels great, very gentle

I absolutely love this product i bought the christmas bundle with the sunday riley night oil and they are literally a present in a bottle. Both products go hand in hand i could have a rough looking skin day and i apply this at night and it absolutely makes my skin brighter and more clear overnight! Totally recommend! 10/10
Too expensive for very little, if any, results. I was very disappointed with this and all the sunday riley products. My skin actually looked worse after using them regularly.

avis.titre: If it's on sale I will repurchase.
avis.texte: I did see improvements with my dark spots and the texture of my skin but I got the smallest size and it lasted about a month and I wasn't even using it daily. The packaging makes it seem like you are getting a lot when in reality you're getting less. It's like a squeezable bag inside the jar. Will only repurchase if it's on sale again.

I did notice a difference with my dark spots, but I got the smallest bottle and it didn't last me more than a month & i wasn't even using it daily. The packaging makes it seem like its a lot but no, when i pulled it out it was a small squeezable package. Not worth what you are paying for this small amount, get it if its on sale!

Boy, this stuff really works! I have some discoloration on both of my cheeks. I used this maybe five times and it has visibly lightened my cheeks! I'm so happy with it. Also, my skin looks smoother and less wrinkled. Love!

This serum has been part of my skin care routine for about two years now. I have seen a significant difference in my complexion and my esthetician compliments my skin. It does what it says, highly recommend ✨✨
Using this for about a month and am pleasantly surprised. I've used good skin care for decades and am so impressed with the simplicity of this product and the powerful results.

I spent a lot of time debating trying this product because it is quite expensive, however I have very dry complicated skin. I have texture and fine lines coming through and my skin has changed since having kids. I've noticed more signs of aging and decided to try this instead of a retinol type product because it seem to fit more what I was looking for. I started using it as suggested for sensitive skin, after my first week I began using it as a leave on serum and my skin has never looked better. I paired this with other products that have peptides (matriculated multi peptide on days I'm not using this and a barrier protector type cream on the days I am) and so far I'm noticing a huge difference in the texture and fine lines and plumpness of my skin as well as moisture retention a big part of that has been using this every other day. On days where I wake up and maybe I've been lazy and my skin has started to show it dullness again, I've been using it in the morning, waiting a few minutes before applying any other skin care, and it revives my skin instantly! as a tired mom I think that's a pretty cool trick.

avis.titre: Nothing happened?? Just irritated my skin a little
avis.texte: Not sure but i didnt notice a single thing ?? Stopped using since it started to burn a little

avis.titre: I wish I hated this product
avis.texte: I am not one to write reviews but I have no choice but to with this one. Let me preface by saying my skin hates EVERYTHING. All SPF, all moisturizer, all face washes, masks, etc., will make me break out in tiny pimples. I have combination skin with pock marks and dark red spots from cysts many years ago that seem like theyll never fade. I got a sample of this product with my birthday code, and it has CHANGED. MY. LIFE. I'm not sure what kind of witchcraft and sorcery they mixed into this serum, but I will never be able to go without it again. Believe me, if there was ANYTHING comparable for even half the price I'd be purchasing that instead, but this is one of a kind. It brightens my skin, leaves it soft and plump, and is FADING MY ACNE SPOTS. I use one full pump for my whole face, and any extra residue drips I kind of press into my deepest pock marks. Complete magic. The issue is that the price tag is painful, borderline unreasonable…however, I tell myself it's still cheaper than dermatologist appointments, multiple trials of products that don't work and end up going to waste, and therapy (kidding). As always, what works for me may not work for you. Definitely get a sample and test it for a few days before committing to the full size. But if it ends up working for you, I can guarantee you will be coming back.

avis.titre: Oh, Good Genes...How I've Missed You!
avis.texte: I can't remember when I received my first bottle of Sunday Riley Good Genes in my Ipsy box, but I remember loving it and then moving on to other products. I recently found that old bottle in my vanity and it had just a smidge left, so I tried it again. I got three nights worth of light use out of it and I knew I had to get another bottle right away. Like a lot of Ipsy subscribers, the fun for me has been in trying new products all the time but at some point, you just have to say "This works, and I'm staying with it." I have had this new bottle for less than a week, and my complexion is already absolutely radiant. Like, no joke - radiant. And I'll be 50 this year, so that is really saying something. My fine lines are reduced, my skin has the smoothest, softest texture, my hyperpigmentation is starting to fade, and it feels like my little luxurious moment of self-care every night. I also recently found a little sample of the Luna Night Sleeping Oil that was still unopened, so I've been using that as well. I've had a full bottle of it in the past, so I'm back on Ulta to purchase Luna again, too. These two products together are truly a fountain of youth, and well worth every penny!

The first time I have ever bought a product after getting a sample! This gives you an immediate glow and makes your skin look so healthy. Worth the price and lasts a long time since you shouldn't use it daily. I didn't notice a smell that some others have mentioned
Ordered .05 size to try before purchasing larger bottle. Not impressed with how the bottle is "painted" to make it look like its product. Small bag inside the bottle with very few applications.

This was one of my first skin care products that introduced me to the world of shin care and it has continued to stick around as my knowledge and collection of products has continued to grow. It just makes my skin so soft and glowy after using it. I mean, do I wish it was cheaper? Yes. Do I wish that more came in the bottle/bag inside? Yes. Do I still begrudgingly fork over the money to repurchase it? Yes.
I'm 40 with sensitive skin and larger pores and uneven redness. I got this as a free sample and love it. I ordered a large version of it soon after using it. Great product. My skin is even and calm.

avis.titre: I hate that i love it😭
avis.texte: I wish i didn't like this product as much as i do because the price is sooo high, but with just 3 nights of using this i have noticed my skin is so glowy and my acne scars are definitely clearing up! highly recommend this product!!

I started using Good Genes a few months ago as per a recommendation from a friend and it really makes my skin soft and helps with discoloration. I use it 2 or 3 times a week in between my normal skin care routine.

I love this product ive been using it for 7 days! Let me preface this by saying i have salicylic acid and glycolic acid given to me by my dermatologist and those really are harsh on my skin. This product had my dark marks peeling away by day 3! I has visibly brighter skin since using it.

I got this product as a sample from Ulta and i loved the immediate results! My skin all the sudden was like glass. I had no idea my skin was dull and in need of a product like this until i applied it. I want to buy the regular size but it is very expensive. Waiting for a salleeeeee!! Highly recommend!!

I recieved a tester with a purchase, and then was like "hmm well let me try a little more" so i bought the "go to bed with me" set to see if it was still just as good, and then i decided it was time to stop playing around and bought the full size. this product is AMAZING! It can be used every day, (its a little tingly) but i have sensitive/combo/ acne prone skin and its now a staple in my rountine. (Sometimes when im lazy its the only thing in my routine.) I honestly can't say enough good things about it. It combats my oily skin, my acne, leaves my face bright and smooth! If you're thinking about buying it, just do it.

avis.titre: If you have allergies or sensitive skin, avoid
avis.texte: I just popped a Benadryl before writing this review. I applied some of the serum to my face and felt a strong burning sensation on the spot where I applied it, followed by tingling and itching all over my body. The ingredient list for this product is a mile long, so I would avoid if you have sensitive or allergic skin.
This product was recommended to me in store and I love it. Alot of products aggravate my skin but this did not!
I love this product! It makes my skin so smooth and even. I only wish I could tell when I'm at the bottom of the bottle.

I really like this exfoliator & I love the smell. I'm used to chemical exfoliants but this one is almost like a serum. It has a bit of a grain texture but it absorbs into the skin exceptionally. I will continue to use because it makes my skin dewy & glowy. Which means that it's doing it's job, getting off all the dead skin.

I loved the instant results. But im allergic to aloe and it is an ingredient. Depending on the amount in products i can sometimes use them. But i got irritated bumps from the aloe . I loved the product and how it made me look. So if you break out from this it may be the aloe if you are sensitive to it. Just a warning. Sad i cant use it .
I've been using this for a couple of years now and have loved it from day one.

I received a deluxe sample and have used it about 4 times now. I use drunk elephant virgin luxury oil first, then good genes, and lastly clinique moisture surge, then eye cream ect.. My face has brightened up, cleared up some minor acne, and made my face overall better, with just 4 uses. I know the price point is high, but when you buy something that actually works, its definitely worth it. Also I do this at night before bed, when I wake up my face is so smooth and soft. it is shrinking my pores. I am 43, I have mature skin, but I leave it on. I do not rinse it till the next morning. Hopefully this helps someone thats on the fence. Oh and it is a lactic acid treatment, you will get a slight tingle, also don't put it on skin that has been picked or pulled open, it will burn for a second. Overall I definitely see a difference, I have ordered more, and I am so happy I was able to try this!
The little sample didn't have instructions. left it on for 16 hours, not 15 minutes....love it! smells bad, but works great! I'll not use it everyday, but 3 times per week.

I was very hesitant to purchase this item after seeing several reviews stating that the bottle isn't actually full of product and is instead there is just a small pouch inside the bottle. This however has not been my experience at all and I received a full bottle of product. I purchased the large bottle through Ulta so I am not sure if maybe bottle size or outside purchases affected what others have received. I love how this product makes my skin look and it has become a daily staple before my moisturizer!

I have been going back to this lactic acid treatment for years. I've probably bought 5 bottles. A little goes a long way. I put this on 3-4 nights a week and my skin is always better than it was the night before. Im in my 30's and have combination skin and acne, and acne scars. This makes my skin radiant and smooth so I feel like I don't need makeup.

I got this in both the AM and PM box kits. I have only been using it a few days, twice a day, and I already see a difference in some of the fine lines on my forehead. I hope that after more consistent use that I will see a lot more of a difference. But so far, so good.

avis.titre: It's a total game changer, the BEST!
avis.texte: Good Genes is the best for my skin. I use it every day in the morning for my morning skin care routine and my skin drinks it up. It looks healthier and brighter, and clear. I have been using Good Genes for several months now, and I'm no longer experiencing any break outs or cystic acne. This is a wonderful moisturizer that I now cannot go without!

I bought this because i needed something to control oil which would reduce break outs thus reduce dark spots. It worked better than expected. I am at an age where I want to invest in my face more than the make-up to cover my face.

started using Good Genes as part of a night time skin regimen. After a week, I decided to used Good Genes both am and pm and in just 4 weeks there is a noticeable difference in my skin. It is firmer, and the abundance of fine lines and wrinkles I have seem to be diminishing. I am 70+ and while I have been aware of skin care it has only been in the last 10 years that I have been diligent. I seem to find products both professional and OTC and use for bursts of time... decided to take the Sunday Riley plunge including Ceramic Slip and Pink Drink. I have previously used good brands of facial cleansers, but again nothing consistent. I am more than pleased and at this stage of life it is nice to have products that integrate and work! These do!

This serum has really changed things for my skin. I don't use it every day but it works almost immediately and makes my skin even and glowing. When I have a big event or something I want to look my best at this is what I turn to. If I use it every day it does make me break out.

avis.titre: 60-year old male and a SR convert
avis.texte: I'm a 60-year old male with some hyperpigmentation and dull skin. Since using GG, the texture and brightness of my face has changed noticeably. I have also incorporating Luna at night and CEO oil in the daytime. I'm a convert to Sunday Riley!

avis.titre: DO NOT BUY! THIS BRAND CHEATS YOU! BUYER BEWARE!
avis.texte: I bought this product on 09/27. I didnt use it everyday moring and night like it says you can do on the bottle. It is now 10/20 and im completely out! So i did some investigating and pulled the lid off and they use a type of plastic bag inside the pretty little glass jar to keep the product in. There for doing that makes you buy more often than othe products. I wanted to love this stuff and did until this evening. This stuff worked. But after seeing them do that and cheat us out of our money i will not be buying again. BUYER BEWARE.

First of all I want to start by saying that the packaging is absolutely gorgeous!! And I love the little samples you get with your order. It's so nice to see a company go above and beyond for their customers. So far I've tried the CEO serum and Good Genes serum and I love everything about them. The smell, the clean feel, and best of all the results. I've gotten so many compliments on my skin! It is spendy but it's so worth it if you're passionate about skincare and don't mind investing in it. I always get so excited when I get my package in the mail. Thanks Sunday Riley for creating high quality and innovative products! You've gained another lifetime customer! 🤍

I love this product and stand by it. It helps me with so many skin concerns such as acne, discoloration, and wrinkles. It's worth the price for me, because it has such impressive results. I put it on after my Luna night oil and wake up with glowing skin.

I have been using Good Genes for the past two years. Although this product is a staple in my skincare routine, I've recently developed a major issue. The latest packaging is a complete fail!! We all know this product is quite pricey and with the new bottle , you get even less product in my opinion. The pump does not evenly dispense and before you know it, you're out of product! I feel slighted on this last purchase and would like to see the brand return to the original pump bottle and NOT the condensed baggy thingy.

avis.titre: Favorite Product in My Skin Care Routine!
avis.texte: Smells and feels amazing, and my skin GLOWS. Have been using this for years and it is my MUST-have. LOVE this product.

I love this product, but this shipment arrived with the top unscrewed and a good portion of the product spilled out. With the cost of the product, I found this concerning. The rest of the products shipped were fine.

I was very skeptical at first. I cannot tell you how amazing this product is!!! Within two days I noticed a HUGE difference. This may seem conceited however I did before pictures, with no filters and two days later I took another photo. The same light, the same position. Generally, I feel I have to use the 'smoothing' filter and the two day later photograph looked like I had used the smoothing filter. You have GOT to try this!!!
I tried a sample of this and immediately noticed a difference in my skin, so I splurged and bought it! At 53 it just makes my skin instantly look brighter and it glows. it's amazing! love!
I like to try different serums for my aging skin and I've never broke out with a rash until I used this serum. If you have sensitive skin you might want to bypass this serum.
Amazing product. Ive purchased this four times. I will not be without ever again!
